section.title: Solving Rational Equations and Radical Equations

title: Solve a rational equation where one root makes a denominator 0
sources: OpenStax College Algebra 2e §2.2 p. 100 (CC BY 4.0): method only

steps.name: multiply both sides by the LCD
throw out answers that make a denominator 0

answer.say: The solution is {r}; {a} is not a solution (division by 0).

mistakes.name: kept the value that makes a denominator 0
mistakes.message: x = {a} makes the denominator 0, so it can't be a solution.

hints.hint: Factor any denominator that is a polynomial.
hints.why: The LCD is built from the factors.
It is the smallest expression every denominator divides into.

hints.step: multiply both sides by the LCD
hints.hint: Multiply every term by the LCD and cancel.

hints.why: It is linear or quadratic now.

hints.step: throw out answers that make a denominator 0
hints.hint: Put each answer into every denominator.
